checks: New listing opens a focused three-phase introduction without global navigation
Selection cards, input fields, and focus advance with the step
Upload failure is retryable; two photos upload and cover selection persists
Empty titles stop the step; Back preserves entered data
390px layout fits; a complete draft does not publish without explicit confirmation
Preview renders the publication and Escape restores focus
Editing after review invalidates the confirmation for the earlier snapshot
Save and exit, reopen, and reload resume the same draft step
A failed cloud save keeps the form open with the input intact; retry recovers
Publication failure shows an error and never shows success
Explicit publish creates the expected snapshot once, then shows success
Legacy review links use the new flow; an update replaces the same publication
Repair records enter the same listing flow while retaining repair data
Direct listing URLs preserve the private access gate
scope: Local Chromium at 1440x960 and 390x844. Isolated in-memory auth, notes, publications and file storage; deliberate save/upload/publish failures. No production writes.

unit_tests.command: node --test tests/listing-flow.test.js tests/domain.test.js tests/sync.test.js tests/private-access.test.js tests/repair-entry.test.js tests/repair-workspace.test.js

reference.used: Three stages: basic information, photos and descriptions, final review and publication. The authenticated Airbnb creation screens were not accessed.
